questions.question: Class A vehicles typically include:
answers: Combination vehicles with a high GCWR / tractor-trailers

questions.question: Before descending a steep grade, you should:
answers: Shift to a lower gear and check brakes

questions.question: The "no-zone" refers to:
answers: Large truck blind spots where cars disappear from view

questions.question: Air brake systems require:
answers: Pre-trip checks of pressure, leaks, and low-pressure warning

questions.question: When turning a long vehicle right:
answers: Swing wide as needed while watching for vehicles cutting inside

questions.question: Cargo securement is important because:
answers: Shifting loads can cause loss of control or spills

questions.question: Following distance for heavy trucks should be:
answers: Longer than for passenger cars due to stopping distance

questions.question: Engine braking helps:
answers: Control speed on downgrades without overheating service brakes

questions.question: If you experience a tire blowout:
answers: Hold the wheel firmly, ease off throttle, then brake gently when stable
Leave the roadway at full speed

questions.question: Overweight loads may:
answers: Damage roads, reduce braking ability, and be illegal

questions.question: Coupling a tractor-trailer requires verifying:
answers: Kingpin engagement, locking jaws, and lines connected
That the trailer is empty always

questions.question: Space management means:
answers: Maintaining cushion space ahead, behind, and to the sides

questions.question: Railroad crossings with long vehicles require:
answers: Ensuring enough space to clear tracks completely before crossing

questions.question: Mirror adjustment on trucks should:
answers: Show mostly your own trailer paint
Minimize blind spots and show adjacent lanes

questions.question: A warning of low air pressure means you should:
answers: Stop safely and not continue until repaired
